propositions: A new locked commit-and-push entrypoint must stage and commit a dirty tracker before delegating to push, while preserving supplied or ambient git identity without mutating global or repository config.

The commit phase must guard against in-progress rebase or merge recovery: strict mode raises PushDeliveryError with merge-recovery-blocked reason; default mode logs warning and returns without staging or pushing.

Lock, staging, and commit failures must raise PushDeliveryError with stable reasons (commit-lock-timeout, stage-failed, commit-failed); strict mode raises immediately, default mode warns and returns without push while retaining uncommitted content for later retry.

The entrypoint must always delegate to push_tickets_branch after successful optional commit, even for clean-but-locally-ahead trees, to ensure delivery; persistent rejection under strict mode preserves the local commit and raises PushDeliveryError rather than reporting success.
The private CLI adapter must expose commit-and-push action with --tracker, --message, --strict, --author-name, and --author-email flags, while keeping the existing push action unchanged.
A clean retry after lock/stage/commit failure or recovery-guard release must succeed in committing and delivering the retained dirty content.
